method: node --expose-gc; import('./apps/gateway/dist/app.js'); call buildApp(); settle 200ms; measure rss/heap delta from baseline + elapsed since start; close app and exit. Env: GOATCITADEL_BUNDLED_POSTGRES_ENABLED=false, GOATCITADEL_DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite, GOATCITADEL_AUTH_MODE=none, GOATCITADEL_LLAMACPP_ENABLED=false, GOATCITADEL_NPU_ENABLED=false, GOATCITADEL_DISABLE_SECRET_STORE=true, GATEWAY_PORT=0, GOATCITADEL_LOG_LEVEL=silent. Each run launched in a fresh node process from the worktree root.
notes: Run 1 was much slower (7.5s) because the gateway materializes config files from examples + warms first-run sqlite schemas on the very first invocation. Runs 2 and 3 reuse those artifacts and are stable at ~2.6s.
Median selected on elapsedMs across the three runs (run 2 is the middle value).
No pre-plan cold-start baseline was captured (baseline.json only logged test counts), so no delta can be reported.
Heap delta is small (~58 MB) and stable across runs; RSS delta of ~141 MB on warm runs is dominated by lazy native deps (better-sqlite3, fastify route compilation, pg).
